title: New ground
The reeve's survey
summary: The quarry of {settlement} is spent. The reeve wants new stone found, {distance} out, before the builders lay down their tools.
offer: Our quarry is done and the builders are idle. I trust you more than the surveyors I can afford: walk the country {distance} round and find us a rock face worth cutting.
complete: Good ground. I will have the quarrymen out by the end of the week.
